items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: And it was Bill that recommended me to Kai for his group. So that’s when Kai called me.

ctx.x: Right. He was not a follower?

It wasn’t anything personal, you know. So I finally went to Woody. Because Bill had always played first trombone in that band. And I finally went to Woody and I says, “You know Woody, — maybe it’d be better for the band if Bill plays first trombone and I follow him.” Well it worked and it was great. Except for those new pieces that Bill didn’t know, and then it was a problem with his time because — he had wonderful time but by the time the thing went from here to here to here it came out late because he was an…
